name: Nike Barcelona Kids Training Dri-Fit Strike

description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike Children's Training Shorts 2026 2027 - Black
description.tagline: Train like the FCB with the Mamba mentality
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Dri-Fit Strike training shorts for children are inspired by the connection between Kobe Bryant and FC Barcelona, ​​transferring the competitive mentality and the search for perfection to each training session. Its design combines performance and style to accompany you in every exercise.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Wicks sweat away to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Mesh panels: Increase ventilation and promote breathability.
Zippered pockets: Allow you to store your items safely.
FC Barcelona Design: Inspired by the legacy of Kobe Bryant and the identity of the Barcelona club.
